bottleneck.current_blocker: Problem validation with paying or committed families, evidence that voice-plus-handwriting experience is meaningfully better than existing alternatives, and demonstrated conversion in at least one distribution channel.

raw.thesis: FreakinGenius (FG) aims to innovate middle school math tutoring by combining an AI-powered voice chatbot with real-time handwritten work analysis on a tablet. The core innovation is the integrated, multimodal learning experience that addresses the expense and scarcity of human tutors. The venture targets middle school students struggling with math, whose parents are willing to pay for a personalized, AI-driven solution. The problem is severe and frequent, as many students fall behind in math, and current tutoring solutions are often inaccessible or cost-prohibitive for many families. The founder seems to be aiming for a growth startup, given the focus on scaling a technological solution within a large market. The venture is currently at the "building" stage, with development started but no validation or users yet. There is no contradiction between the intake form and any uploaded documents, as no documents were provided. The venture aims to replace traditional human tutors while complementing the existing educational framework by providing an accessible and personalized alternative.
raw.product_description: FreakinGenius (FG) is an AI-powered math tutoring service for middle school students who struggle with math. The product offers a dual experience: an AI voice chatbot that replaces the human tutor, paired with a tablet app that analyzes the student's handwritten work in real-time and feeds signals back to the chatbot. All interaction between the student and the AI is voice-based.
raw.core_excitement: The founder is excited by the opportunity to address the scarcity and high cost of human math tutors with an integrated AI-powered voice chatbot and real-time handwriting analysis system.

what_founder_has_not_told_us: how they plan to acquire customers (distribution channels)
founder's resources (money and time available for 3 months)

raw.what_makes_this_different: FreakinGenius differentiates itself by offering a unique, integrated learning experience that combines an AI voice chatbot with real-time analysis of handwritten work on a tablet, a combination not currently available in the market.

extraction_sources.source_phrase: No existing product combines real-time handwriting analysis with a voice AI tutor in a single integrated experience.
Course subscription: $79/month. Tablet fee: $2.30/month (15% margin on hardware, amortized over 36 months).

Total AI cost per user per month: $11.50 (speech-to-text $2, text-to-speech $2, LLM inference $4, writing analysis $2, generative media $1.50). BNPL partner fronts tablet hardware; FreakinGenius repays $13.26/month per teacher over 36 months. Teacher revenue share: $15/month per active subscriber.

raw.evidence_of_stage: Started building. No validation completed. No users. No paid customers. No LOIs.
